recipe.name: Aloo Tamatar sabji (Aloo Pyaz Tamatar Ki Sabji)
directions: In a pressure cooker, add mustard oil, once it's smoky hot, add cumin seeds, fennel seeds, small mustard seeds, black peppercorns and let it splutter well.
Add a pinch of asafoetida, onions and cook for a while.
Add tomatoes and cook it for a while, add degi red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, potatoes, salt to taste, water and give it a good mix.
Cover it with the lid and pressure cook it for 1-2 whistles or until cooked well.
Finish it with prepared tadka, fresh coriander leaves and mix well.
Transfer it to a serving dish and garnish it with coriander sprig.
In a pan, add ghee, once it's hot, add dry red chillies and fry them for a while.
Add tomato, salt to taste and toss them for a minute.
